Resource Profile: MII PR ICU Score SOFA

Official URL: https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-icu/StructureDefinition/mii-pr-icu-score-sofa Version: 2027.0.0-ballot.rc1
Draft as of 2026-08-31 Computable Name: MII_PR_ICU_Score_SOFA

Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score for assessing organ dysfunction in critically ill patients. Evaluates six organ systems (respiratory, cardiovascular, hepatic, coagulation, renal, neurological), each scored 0-4 points. Total score ranges from 0 to 24, with higher scores indicating more severe organ dysfunction.

Usages:

  • This Profile is not used by any profiles in this Specification

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
dom-2 error Observation If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources contained.contained.empty()
dom-3 error Observation If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4 error Observation If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5 error Observation If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6 best practice Observation A resource should have narrative for robust management text.`div`.exists()
ele-1 error **ALL** elements All FHIR elements must have a @value or children hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1 error **ALL** extensions Must have either extensions or value[x], not both extension.exists() != value.exists()
mii-icu-comp-xor-val error Observation If there is no component or hasMember element then either a value[x] or a data absent reason must be present (component.empty() and hasMember.empty()) implies (dataAbsentReason.exists() xor value.exists())
mii-icu-enc-or-sub error Observation Either subject OR encounter exists $this.encounter.exists() or $this.subject.exists()
mii-icu-loinc-sct-dgai-ieee11073 error Observation.code Es muss mindestens ein LOINC, SnomedCT, IEEE-11073 oder DGAI Code vorhanden sein coding.where(system= $loinc ).exists() or coding.where(system= $sct ).exists() or coding.where(system= $dgai).exists() or coding.where(system= $ieee-11073).exists()
mii-icu-val-xor-dar error Observation, Observation.component, Observation.component:respiratory, Observation.component:cardiovascular, Observation.component:hepatic, Observation.component:coagulation, Observation.component:renal, Observation.component:neurological Resource must have either value or dataAbsentReason. value.exists() xor dataAbsentReason.exists()
obs-3 error Observation.referenceRange Must have at least a low or a high or text low.exists() or high.exists() or text.exists()
obs-6 error Observation dataAbsentReason SHALL only be present if Observation.value[x] is not present dataAbsentReason.empty() or value.empty()
obs-7 error Observation If Observation.code is the same as an Observation.component.code then the value element associated with the code SHALL NOT be present value.empty() or component.code.where(coding.intersect(%resource.code.coding).exists()).empty()
sofa-component-range error Observation.component:respiratory.value[x]:valueInteger, Observation.component:cardiovascular.value[x]:valueInteger, Observation.component:hepatic.value[x]:valueInteger, Observation.component:coagulation.value[x]:valueInteger, Observation.component:renal.value[x]:valueInteger, Observation.component:neurological.value[x]:valueInteger SOFA component score must be between 0 and 4 valueInteger >= 0 and valueInteger <= 4
sofa-score-range error Observation.value[x]:valueInteger SOFA total score must be between 0 and 24 valueInteger >= 0 and valueInteger <= 24

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
dom-2 error Observation If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources contained.contained.empty()
dom-3 error Observation If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4 error Observation If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5 error Observation If a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6 best practice Observation A resource should have narrative for robust management text.`div`.exists()
ele-1 error **ALL** elements All FHIR elements must have a @value or children hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1 error **ALL** extensions Must have either extensions or value[x], not both extension.exists() != value.exists()
mii-icu-comp-xor-val error Observation If there is no component or hasMember element then either a value[x] or a data absent reason must be present (component.empty() and hasMember.empty()) implies (dataAbsentReason.exists() xor value.exists())
mii-icu-enc-or-sub error Observation Either subject OR encounter exists $this.encounter.exists() or $this.subject.exists()
mii-icu-loinc-sct-dgai-ieee11073 error Observation.code Es muss mindestens ein LOINC, SnomedCT, IEEE-11073 oder DGAI Code vorhanden sein coding.where(system= $loinc ).exists() or coding.where(system= $sct ).exists() or coding.where(system= $dgai).exists() or coding.where(system= $ieee-11073).exists()
mii-icu-val-xor-dar error Observation, Observation.component, Observation.component:respiratory, Observation.component:cardiovascular, Observation.component:hepatic, Observation.component:coagulation, Observation.component:renal, Observation.component:neurological Resource must have either value or dataAbsentReason. value.exists() xor dataAbsentReason.exists()
obs-3 error Observation.referenceRange Must have at least a low or a high or text low.exists() or high.exists() or text.exists()
obs-6 error Observation dataAbsentReason SHALL only be present if Observation.value[x] is not present dataAbsentReason.empty() or value.empty()
obs-7 error Observation If Observation.code is the same as an Observation.component.code then the value element associated with the code SHALL NOT be present value.empty() or component.code.where(coding.intersect(%resource.code.coding).exists()).empty()
sofa-component-range error Observation.component:respiratory.value[x]:valueInteger, Observation.component:cardiovascular.value[x]:valueInteger, Observation.component:hepatic.value[x]:valueInteger, Observation.component:coagulation.value[x]:valueInteger, Observation.component:renal.value[x]:valueInteger, Observation.component:neurological.value[x]:valueInteger SOFA component score must be between 0 and 4 valueInteger >= 0 and valueInteger <= 4
sofa-score-range error Observation.value[x]:valueInteger SOFA total score must be between 0 and 24 valueInteger >= 0 and valueInteger <= 24
